name: Perplexity
tagline: Search the web and your files with AI answers linked to supporting sources.
description: Perplexity is an AI search service that combines web retrieval with conversational answers and source citations. Ask a question, follow the linked evidence, and refine the search with follow-up prompts. Supported file and project workflows add your own materials, while research features can produce a broader synthesis of a complex topic. Access and usage vary by plan.

features.label: Web answers with citations
features.text: Get a synthesized answer alongside links to sources you can open and inspect.

features.label: Files and project context
features.text: Use supported uploads and project features to bring your own information into a search workflow.

features.label: Deeper research
features.text: Research features investigate complex questions across sources and organize the findings into a cited report.

useCases.label: Orient yourself on a topic
useCases.text: Start with a question, read the cited material, and use follow-up prompts to explore details or competing explanations.

useCases.label: Combine external and internal context
useCases.text: Search public information alongside supported uploaded files when preparing a comparison or research briefing.

limitations: Review the cited evidence before relying on a conclusion; a synthesized answer is a starting point for checking sources.
Advanced searches, research, model access, and uploads have different allowances across plans.
Programmatic API access is a separate product with its own billing and does not inherit a web subscription's features.
guide.pricingNote: Core search is available on a Free plan. Paid individual and organization plans offer different capabilities and allowances; consult the official comparison for current limits.

alternatives.reason: Compare for a general assistant with research and file workflows.
Compare for research organized around a selected source collection.

faqs.question: Does Perplexity link to the sources behind an answer?
faqs.answer: Perplexity's search answers include citations that link to supporting sources. Open those references to check the evidence and its context.

faqs.question: Can I upload files to Perplexity?
faqs.answer: Yes. File uploads are supported, with limited access on the Free plan and different upload and analysis allowances on paid plans. Check the current plan comparison.
